[EN] So sorry, tour's full. If you're interested, we leave on every even hour. Meals not provided, weapons not included.

Not that you need weapons. Well, probably you won't.
[ES] Lo siento mucho, el tour está lleno. Si te interesa, salimos cada hora par. Comidas no incluidas, armas no incluidas.

No es que necesites armas. Bueno, probablemente no las necesites.
